claims.claim: First grade Tokumbo tires that will last almost like new brand ones
claims.evidence: Subjective quality claim; no photo can confirm performance or 'first grade' status
Tread pattern is visible in photos 0 and 1 but no depth gauge or measurement shown to confirm percentage
Inner liner / patch area not shown in any photo
Sidewalls are only partially visible (photo 1, 2); full circumference not shown to rule out bulges
Source vehicle cannot be confirmed from tire photos alone

risks.risk: Tire size (width/aspect/rim diameter) unknown, may not fit buyer's vehicle
risks.proof: Close-up of sidewall size markings (e.g. 205/55R16) for each tire
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/unconfirmed size, worst case mismatch with buyer's need

risks.risk: Actual age via DOT code may be older than claimed 2023 removal
risks.proof: Clear photo of DOT date code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, worst case treated as older stock

risks.risk: Tread depth not actually measured, could be lower than claimed 90 percent
risks.proof: Photo of tread depth gauge inserted into groove
risks.if_unproven: priced as low/worn tread until measured

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall cracks, bulges or repairs not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Full 360-degree sidewall video or close-up shots of each tire, inside and out
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged/repaired until shown clean

risks.risk: Tires may not match in brand, size or model despite being sold as a set
risks.proof: Clear sidewall shot of all tires showing brand/size side by side
risks.if_unproven: priced as mismatched set, worst case

risks.risk: Unclear total quantity being sold (photos show 1 then 2 tires)
risks.proof: Single photo showing full count of all tires included in sale, laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest count shown (worst case fewer tires)

risks.risk: Load index and speed rating unknown, may not suit vehicle requirements
risks.proof: Close-up of sidewall load/speed rating text
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/base rating, no premium applied

proof_requests: Clear sidewall photo of each tire showing size, DOT date code, load index and speed rating
Tread depth gauge measurement photo for each tire
Full set photo showing exact number of tires for sale, laid side by side
Close-up photos of inner liner and full sidewall circumference for each tire to check for patches, plugs, cracks or bulges
response.reason: The witness confirms these are used (Tokumbo) car tires, so the item type is settled and can be priced at worst case given unverified condition, size, age and quantity claims.
